snippet.title: Granite Noir: The Social Experiment | Game Trailer
snippet.description:
🖤 GRANITE NOIR: The Social Experiment 🖤

You enter a dark room. A timer begins: 2 hours.
When it reaches zero, you get ONE wish to shape the game.
Every wish is granted. Every wish is permanent.
The game doesn't exist yet. You will create it.

💎 ONE WISH. ONE OPPORTUNITY.
⏱️ TWO HOURS OF WAITING.
🌍 INFINITE POSSIBILITIES.

🎮 Wishlist NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078640/Granite_Noir_The_Social_Experiment

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 WHAT IS GRANITE NOIR?

An experimental social game where YOU shape the future for all players.
- Wait 2 hours in contemplation
- Make ONE wish for a feature/addition
- Developers implement EVERY wish (no refusals)
- Your wish is engraved forever on the black granite monolith

Early players buy the POWER to CREATE the game, not a finished product.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 KEY FEATURES:
✓ Unique social experiment
✓ Player-driven development
✓ Permanent consequences
✓ Shared evolving world
✓ Philosophical contemplation experience


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
